Privacy Policy

At SUNCITY PALLETS LIQUIDATION STORE LLC, accessible from https://firebrick-dugong-592049.hostingersite.com, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. SUNCITY PALLETS LIQUIDATION STORE LLC is a Limited Liability Company incorporated in the United States on 2025-05-03 with registry number 0806021894. Our legal address is 328 Thomas Pl, Everman, TX 76140, USA. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by SUNCITY PALLETS LIQUIDATION STORE LLC and how we use it. If you have additional questions or require more information about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us.

1. Consent

By using our Website, you hereby consent to our Privacy Policy and agree to its terms.

2. Information We Collect

The personal information that you are asked to provide, and the reasons why you are asked to provide it, will be made clear to you at the point we ask you to provide your personal information.

  • Account Information: If you register for an Account, we may ask for your contact information, including items such as name, company name, address, email address, and telephone number.
  • Order and Checkout Data: When you purchase products, we collect transaction information, shipping address, billing address, and items ordered to process and deliver your cargo.
  • Payment Processing: Your payment information is collected and processed securely by our third-party payment gateways (such as Stripe). We do not store or retain your full credit/debit card numbers on our servers.
  • Direct Communications: If you contact us directly, we may receive additional information about you such as your name, email address, phone number, the contents of the message and/or attachments you may send us, and any other information you may choose to provide.

3. How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect in various ways, including to:

  • Provide, operate, and maintain our Website and e-commerce services
  • Improve, personalize, and expand our Website
  • Understand and analyze how you use our Website
  • Develop new products, services, features, and functionality
  • Process your transactions and arrange standard or freight shipping
  • Communicate with you, either directly or through one of our partners, including for customer service, to provide you with updates and other information relating to the Website, and for marketing and promotional purposes
  • Send you emails, invoice confirmations, and shipment tracking numbers
  • Find and prevent fraud and secure our web systems

4. Log Files

SUNCITY PALLETS LIQUIDATION STORE LLC follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. All hosting companies do this and a part of hosting services’ analytics. The information collected by log files include internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users’ movement on the website, and gathering demographic information.

5. Cookies and Web Beacons

Like any other website, SUNCITY PALLETS LIQUIDATION STORE LLC uses “cookies.” These cookies are used to store information including visitors’ preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited. The information is used to optimize the users’ experience by customizing our web page content based on visitors’ browser type and/or other information.

6. Third-Party Partners and Services

We share relevant data with trusted third-party service providers to perform functions on our behalf:

  • Payment Gateways: We use Stripe for secure payment processing. Stripe handles card data in compliance with PCI-DSS standards.
  • Logistics and Freight Carriers: Shipping and freight information is shared with LTL carriers, UPS, FedEx, or shipping forwarders to arrange delivery of liquidation pallets.
  • Search and Analytics Providers: We utilize search indexers (such as Algolia) and analytics tools to index products and improve site navigation.

7. GDPR & CCPA Data Protection Rights

We want to ensure you are fully aware of all of your data protection rights. Every user is entitled to the following:

  • The right to access: You have the right to request copies of your personal data.
  • The right to rectification: You have the right to request that we correct any information you believe is inaccurate.
  • The right to erasure: You have the right to request that we erase your personal data, under certain conditions.
  • The right to restrict processing: You have the right to request that we restrict the processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
  • The right to object to processing: You have the right to object to our processing of your personal data, under certain conditions.
  • The right to data portability: You have the right to request that we transfer the data that we have collected to another organization, or directly to you, under certain conditions.

8. Children’s Information

Another part of our priority is adding protection for children while using the internet. We encourage parents and guardians to observe, participate in, and/or monitor and guide their online activity. SUNCITY PALLETS LIQUIDATION STORE LLC does not knowingly collect any Personal Identifiable Information from children under the age of 13. If you think that your child provided this kind of information on our website, we strongly encourage you to contact us immediately and we will do our best efforts to promptly remove such information from our records.

9. Security

We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information when you place an order or enter, submit, or access your personal information. We utilize Secure Socket Layer (SSL) technology to encrypt data in transit. However, no electronic transmission over the internet or database storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee its absolute safety.

Delivery Policy

Shipping wholesale liquidation pallets is often not as straightforward as shipping regular goods. At SUNCITY PALLETS LIQUIDATION STORE LLC we use a variety of materials to package and ship our merchandise, the most common being cases, bins, gaylords, or shrink-wrapped pallets. Our clients typically ship their goods by Courier (UPS/FedEx), LTL (Less than Load) Carriers, Full Trailers, or Containers.

This Shipping Policy (“Policy”) outlines the terms and conditions governing the shipping of products purchased from SUNCITY PALLETS LIQUIDATION STORE LLC (“Company,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) through our website https://firebrick-dugong-592049.hostingersite.com(“Website”). SUNCITY PALLETS LIQUIDATION STORE LLC is a Limited Liability Company incorporated in the United States on 2025-05-03 with registry number 0806021894. Our legal address is 328 Thomas Pl, Everman, TX 76140, USA. By placing an order and using our services, you (“Customer,” “you,” or “your”) agree to comply with this Policy.

1. Shipping Methods and Timeframes

We strive to provide efficient and reliable shipping services to our customers. We currently offer the following shipping methods within the United States:

  • Standard Shipping: Orders shipped via Standard Shipping are typically delivered within 5-7 business days from the date of shipment.
  • Express Shipping: For customers who require expedited delivery, we offer Express Shipping. Orders shipped via Express Shipping are typically delivered within 1-3 business days from the date of shipment.

Please note that the delivery timeframes mentioned above are estimates and may be subject to occasional delays beyond our control, such as during peak seasons or unforeseen circumstances.

2. Shipping Charges

Shipping charges are determined based on various factors, including the weight, dimensions, and destination of the package. The applicable shipping charges will be calculated and displayed at checkout before you confirm your purchase. Additional charges may apply for expedited shipping options. We reserve the right to update our shipping charges at any time without prior notice, but such changes will not affect orders that have already been placed.

3. Order Processing Time

Once your order has been successfully placed and payment has been verified, we will process your order within 2 to 4 business days. Processing times may vary depending on factors such as order volume and product availability. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays will be processed on the next business day.

4. Shipment Confirmation and Tracking

Once your order has been shipped, we will send you a shipment confirmation email containing the tracking number and a link to track your package. You can also find this information by logging into your account on our Website. It is your responsibility to ensure that the shipping address provided is accurate and complete. We are not responsible for any delays or issues caused by incorrect shipping information provided by the customer.

5. Domestic vs. International Shipping

Standard checkout shipping through our Website is only offered within the United States. We do not provide automatic international shipping at checkout (including U.S. territories and APO/FPO addresses) for standard orders.

However, because we deal with wholesale pallets and bulk containers, international freight shipping is available upon custom inquiry. Please refer to Section 11 (International Freight Shipping) for detailed rules, rates, and compliance terms.

6. Order Modifications and Cancellations

Once an order has been placed, modifications or cancellations may not be possible. If you need to make any changes to your order, please contact our customer support team immediately. We will do our best to accommodate your request, but we cannot guarantee that changes can be made after an order has been processed.

7. Lost or Damaged Shipments

While we take great care in packing and shipping your orders, there may be rare instances where a package is lost or damaged during transit. If your package is lost or arrives damaged, please contact our customer support team within 7 days of receiving your order. We will work with you to resolve the issue and initiate a claim with the shipping carrier if necessary.

8. Returns and Exchanges

For information on our return and exchange policy, please refer to our Refund Policy page.

9. Compliance with Laws and Regulations

We comply with all applicable laws and regulations regarding the shipping of products. It is your responsibility to ensure that any products you purchase comply with the laws and regulations of your jurisdiction. We reserve the right to refuse or cancel an order if we believe it violates any laws or regulations.

10. Shipping Cost Calculations

The cost of shipping by Courier or LTL is typically determined by the distance between the origin and destination of the goods, the type of destination, the type of merchandise, and the weight or quantity of the merchandise being shipped. The cost of shipping by Full Truckload or Ocean Container is typically determined by the distance between the origin and the destination of the goods.

11. International Freight Shipping

For international wholesale shipments, please take note of the following rules:

  • Ocean Freight Rates: Ocean freight charges can run from $300 to $700 per pallet, depending on the destination. These rates are typically uneconomical in our industry for lower-value pallets.
  • Container Shipping: Container Loads are the most cost-effective way to ship larger amounts of merchandise overseas. Ocean freight can cost between $2,500 to $6,500 for a full container, depending on the container size (20′, 40′, 45′) and the destination.
  • Import Restrictions: Many countries restrict what types of goods can be imported. Furthermore, brand protection and agency rights in place may prohibit the importation of certain brands into the country other than from the authorized importer.
  • Buyer’s Responsibility:It is the buyer’s sole responsibility to be informed of particular restrictions in the destination country. SUNCITY PALLETS LIQUIDATION STORE LLC cannot be held responsible for merchandise seized or refused at customs. Please familiarize yourself with these costs and ensure you can clear customs before placing an order.
  • CBP Inspections and Customs Duties:U.S. Customs & Border Protection (CBP) has broad authority to inspect export cargo. The cost of inspections ordered by CBP is the responsibility of the consignee. All customs clearance fees, import duties, and related taxes are also the responsibility of the consignee. When appropriate, please verify that the Seal # matches the paperwork and has not been tampered with.
  • Manifest Limitations: We export dozens of orders weekly, and in over 98% of cases, orders clear customs without issue. However, due to the nature of liquidation, we are usually unable to provide detailed manifests and country of origin details. Clearing customs with such goods can on rare occasions be problematic, and SUNCITY PALLETS LIQUIDATION STORE LLC does not control that aspect of the sale.
